capabilities: Fetch intelligence reports from the Trawl API via the "Fetch Trawl Report" command
Save reports as Markdown notes covering sentiment, filings, and trading data
Configure a Trawl API key in plugin settings
extras: The README only covers installation and basic usage; report contents and API limits are not documented. The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull outside financial and market intelligence data in as notes.
summary: Fetches Trawl intelligence reports—AI summaries, Reddit sentiment, SEC filings, insider and congressional trading—into the vault as Markdown notes.
